text: Run a browser task with just a few lines of code via SDK/API
quote: Plug-and-play: Run a task in just 4 lines of code, making it easy to integrate into your workflow.

text: Provides a live_url to watch agent actions in real time
quote: When running a task, you will receive a `live_url`, which can be used to view the agent actions live.

text: Log in once and reuse that authentication session for future tasks
quote: Log in once, then reuse that authentication for future tasks.

text: Supports specifying a proxy server in task parameters
quote: To use a proxy with Smooth, you need to specify the proxy server details in your task parameters.

text: Structured outputs let you get schema-validated, typed data from the agent's results
quote: Extract structured data from the current page by providing a schema.

text: Lets you register custom arbitrary functions as tools for the agent
quote: Custom tools allow you to give Smooth any arbitrary function as a tool.

text: Session Workflow mode orchestrates multi-step tasks, navigation, and data extraction in one persistent browser session
quote: Session Workflow — Multi-step execution where you can orchestrate smaller tasks, navigate to URLs, and extract data within a persistent browser session.

text: Automatically bypasses CAPTCHA challenges during task execution
quote: Auto-CAPTCHA solvers: Bypass CAPTCHA challenges automatically, allowing for uninterrupted task execution.

text: Official CLI lets AI agents like Claude Code drive a browser
quote: The Smooth CLI is a browser for AI agents, enabling tools like Claude Code to navigate the web quickly, cheaply, and reliably.

text: Zero Data Retention enterprise feature allows deleting all data tied to completed tasks
quote: Zero Data Retention is an enterprise feature that provides enhanced data privacy by allowing you to delete all data associated with completed tasks.

text: Uses small, efficient AI models to make task execution 7x cheaper than competitors
quote: Smooth uses small and efficient AI models, making it 7x more affordable than browser-use.

text: Can create a P2P tunnel through your own machine to route traffic and access localhost
quote: Set to `"self"` to create a P2P tunnel through your machine, routing traffic via your IP and enabling access to localhost.
